evidence_summary.binding_rationale: Text normalization, spelling correction, and synonym expansion are dataset-specific preprocessing.
Lexical feature extraction is implemented from standard string and sparse-vector operations.
Embedding sources vary across competitions and may come from pretrained vectors or fitted decompositions.
Graph, frequency, and leakage-safe context features are competition-specific.
The ensemble can be implemented with tree, linear, kernel, or blended learners.
Metric thresholding and transitive closure are validation-driven post-processing.
